title: How Many Bytes Has a BPE Model Seen? Estimating Byte-Token Exposure in Pretraining from Corpus Statistics and Embedding Norms
abstract: arXiv:2611.27506v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Byte-level BPE vocabularies retain 256 single-byte fallback tokens. When converting such a model into a pure byte-level model, these tokens provide the starting embeddings. How much training have they received? We estimate byte-token exposure in Qwen3.8 using two independent routes. First, we tokenize 540 MB of public corpora covering 40 domains and 33 languages, then combine per-domain token shares with assumed pretraining mixtures. Single-byte tokens account for 13 to 36% of tokens, mostly ASCII; genuine UTF-8 fallback bytes (0x80-0xFF) account for 0.15 to 0.27% under mainstream mixtures, or about 2 billion occurrences per trillion pretraining tokens. Fallback rates vary by four orders of magnitude across languages, reflecting how well each script is covered by the vocabulary. translated_title: BPE模型见过多少字节？基于语料库统计与嵌入范数估计预训练中的字节token暴露量
translated_abstract: 字节级BPE词表保留了256个单字节后备token。当将此类模型转换为纯字节级模型时，这些token提供了起始嵌入，但它们在预训练中获得了多少训练？本文通过两条独立路径估计了Qwen3.8中的字节token暴露量。首先，对覆盖40个领域和33种语言的540 MB公开语料库进行分词，并将各领域的token占比与假设的预训练数据混合比例相结合。结果显示，单字节token占总token数的13%至36%，主要为ASCII字符；在主流混合比例下，真正的UTF-8后备字节（0x80-0xFF）仅占0.15%至0.27%，即每万亿个预训练token中约出现20亿次。后备率在不同语言之间相差达四个数量级，反映出各书写系统被词表覆盖的程度差异。其次，分析了四个开源模型的嵌入矩阵和输出矩阵的行范数，以未训练的padding行作为零暴露基线，并利用普通token的（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过语料库分词统计与嵌入范数分析两条独立路径，量化估计了BPE模型中256个单字节后备token在预训练中的暴露程度，发现真正的UTF-8后备字节仅占总token的0.15%至0.27%，且后备率在不同语言间相差达四个数量级。
